pictures.scene: Hans Memling, Virgin Enthroned with Child and Two Angels Making Music — the angels bent over their instruments beside the throne, sing to the LORD a new song, all the earth
pictures.name: pd_memling_lied

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, St Peter Preaching in the Presence of St Mark — the apostle standing up over the listening crowd with his hand raised, bless His name and proclaim His salvation day after day
pictures.name: pd_angelico_naam

pictures.scene: Titian, The Descent of the Holy Spirit — the flames coming down on the gathered disciples in the opened light, declare His glory among the nations and His wonders among all peoples
pictures.name: pd_titiaan_wonderen

pictures.scene: Albert Bierstadt, Mount Corcoran — the great peak standing up over the still lake and the dark pines, for great is the LORD and greatly to be praised
pictures.name: pd_bierstadt_groot

pictures.scene: Adriaen van Stalbemt, Paul and Barnabas at Lystra — the apostles tearing their clothes to stop the people sacrificing to them before the idol's temple, all the gods of the nations are idols but the LORD made the heavens
pictures.name: pd_stalbemt_afgoden

pictures.scene: Giovanni Paolo Panini, Interior of Saint Peter's, Rome — the enormous nave opening away under its vaults and gold, splendor and majesty are before Him and beauty fills His sanctuary
pictures.name: pd_panini_heiligdom

pictures.scene: Diego Velázquez, The Adoration of the Magi — the kings of distant peoples kneeling with their gifts before the Child, ascribe to the LORD, O families of the nations
pictures.name: pd_velazquez_geslachten

pictures.scene: Konrad Witz, King Solomon and the Queen of Sheba — the queen holding out a tall golden vessel to the seated king against a ground of tooled gold, bring an offering and enter His courts
pictures.name: pd_witz_offer

pictures.scene: Raphael, Disputation of the Holy Sacrament — the Father in the rays above, Christ enthroned in glory, and the doctors below at the altar, worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness
pictures.name: pd_raphael_aanbid

pictures.scene: Jan van Goyen, View of Dordrecht — the church tower and the windmills standing firm over the wide river under a great sky, the LORD reigns, the world is firmly established and cannot be moved
pictures.name: pd_goyen_wereld

pictures.scene: Riccardo Quartararo, The Archangel Michael — the archangel in armour holding the balance level with the devil under his feet, He will judge the peoples with equity, let the heavens be glad
pictures.name: pd_quartararo_recht

pictures.scene: Albert Bierstadt, Seal Rock — the green wave breaking white over the rock with the sea lions and the gulls, let the earth rejoice and the sea resound
pictures.name: pd_bierstadt_zee

pictures.scene: Vincent van Gogh, Green Wheat Fields, Auvers — the young wheat running in waves with yellow flowers under a swirling sky, let the fields exult and all that fills them
pictures.name: pd_vangogh_velden

pictures.scene: Asher Brown Durand, The Beeches — the tall beeches standing over the shepherd and his flock in the evening light, then all the trees of the forest
pictures.name: pd_durand_bomen

pictures.scene: Lucas Cranach the Elder, The Sermon of Saint John the Baptist — the Baptist preaching from the tree stump to the crowd in the wood, they sing for joy before the LORD, for He is coming
pictures.name: pd_cranach_juichen

pictures.scene: Jan van Eyck, The Last Judgment — Christ enthroned under the cross with Mary and the Baptist and the ranks of the saints while Michael stands over the rising dead, He is coming to judge the earth in righteousness
pictures.name: pd_eyck_oordeel

pictures.scene: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, The Numbering at Bethlehem — the whole village crowding to be counted in the snow under the red winter sun, and the peoples in His faithfulness
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_volkeren

lines.text: Sing to the LORD a new song;
sing to the LORD, all the earth.
Sing to the LORD, bless His name;
proclaim His salvation day after day.
Declare His glory among the nations,
His wonders among all peoples.
For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised;
He is to be feared above all gods.
For all the gods of the nations are idols,
but it is the LORD who made the heavens.
Splendor and majesty are before Him;
strength and beauty fill His sanctuary.
Ascribe to the LORD, O families of the nations,
ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name;
bring an offering and enter His courts.
Worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness;
tremble before Him, all the earth.
Declare among the nations: “The LORD reigns!”
The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved;
He will judge the peoples with equity.
Let the heavens be glad
and the earth rejoice;
let the sea resound,
and all that fills it.
Let the fields exult,
and all that is in them.
Then all the trees of the forest
will sing for joy before the LORD,
for He is coming—
He is coming to judge the earth.
He will judge the world in righteousness
and the peoples in His faithfulness.
